[2026-06-01 22:14] RED — season date-format bug fix on `fix/season-date-format`. Act this turn.

WORKSPACE: `cd /home/michelek/workspace/.claude/worktrees/season-date-format` → `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/fix/season-date-format` (tip `e7f7d49`, off main). If `pnpm check` complains PUBLIC_ENTU_DB → `cp .env.example .env` (gitignored).

THE BUG (root cause confirmed by live probe): Entu returns `date`-typed values as full ISO — Pérotin probed the live EFK season and `start_date[0].date` = **`"2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z"`** (NOT `"2026-06-02"`). `listSeasons` (`src/lib/seasons/entuSeasons.ts`) maps `startDate: raw.start_date?.[0]?.date` and `endDate: raw.end_date?.[0]?.date` — handing the full ISO straight to `SeasonForm`'s `<input type="date">`, which can only render `YYYY-MM-DD`, so the field shows BLANK and date edits don't round-trip. Fix = normalize to `YYYY-MM-DD` in `listSeasons` (`.slice(0, 10)`).

RED TEST (`src/lib/seasons/entuSeasons.spec.ts`, listSeasons describe block):
- Drive the REAL producer with the REAL format (no objectingContaining shortcuts, per feedback_partial_assertions_hide_bugs). Mock `fetch` to return a season search response whose value carries the probed shape:
  `start_date: [{ _id: 'v1', date: '2026-06-02T00:00:00.000Z' }]`, `end_date: [{ _id: 'v2', date: '2026-07-28T00:00:00.000Z' }]`, plus a `name: [{string:'Fooz'}]`.
- Assert the mapped season has `startDate === '2026-06-02'` and `endDate === '2026-07-28'` (full-shape `toEqual` on the season object is ideal). Currently returns the full ISO → RED.
- Add a guard case: an already-clean `date: '2027-01-15'` still maps to `'2027-01-15'` (slice is idempotent), and a missing date maps to `''` (existing `?? ''` preserved).

VERIFY: `pnpm test src/lib/seasons/entuSeasons.spec.ts` → the new assertions FAIL for the right reason (full ISO vs sliced); everything else green. `pnpm check` 0. Commit on `fix/season-date-format` (no `Co-authored-by:` line), push. REPORT to team-lead: SHA + which assertions are RED. Then Josquin makes the one-line GREEN in listSeasons.

NOTE: this is data-layer only (Josquin's GREEN). No SeasonForm/.svelte change, no i18n. The #87 rehearsal-edit datetime path is NOT affected (it already has a `toDatetimeLocal` converter) — don't touch it.
